summary: Accepted user decision: the trusted Home route can retain a verified committed export after retiring the original source filesystem; it does not require preservation of old device/inode/owner identity. Home is the trusted local execution owner, so a separate privileged reader, signing key or production reader attestation is not a prerequisite for this route. This does not promise protection against compromised Home or weaken unrelated profiles. Home supplies the machine/provider proposal; the coordinator owns protected workflow/source integration. Keep the same original context, journal/key and CAS. Quiesce before copy and commit exact retained observation bytes before removal. Read never grants cleanup; only the first successful BeginCleanup reply supplies a consumed permission. Lost replies and expired windows do not grant replay. Explicit finite cleanup-only recovery binds the same original and committed export to current resource observations; it neither renews useful work nor recopies. Image manifest/repository references and configuration IDs require actual metadata mapping, not equal digest tails. Dedicated-runner source was delivered by Coordination PR1063 at a6196dc3. Its16GiB reference does not replace actual14GiB available-memory/80GiB free-space gates, supported capacity/write-domain enforcement, authenticated input closure or physical lifecycle and disposal proofs. Source delivery and scoped tests are distinct from provisioning, installed Home/runtime acceptance, publication/adoption and separate two-machine qualification. Original outcomes, first causes and historical Unknowns remain at their actual scope. Consult live owning issues for operational status; this record carries no runtime admission.
title: Trusted Home commits exports and supplies the dedicated qualification target
